track.title: Where is my order?

seo.title: Where is my order? - Help Center
seo.description: Check your order status at Superior Hypermarket: pending, confirmed, processing, shipped or completed.

track.intro: You can check your order status anytime from your account.
steps: Sign in and go to My Orders.
Find the order by its number (e.g. #ORD-12345) and check its status.
Statuses are: pending, confirmed, processing, shipped, completed or cancelled.
Open details to see history and delivery address.
track.note: If your order does not appear, verify you signed in with the purchase email.
track.related: Is your order delayed? Check the late delivery article.

cancel.title: Can I cancel my order?

seo.title: Can I cancel my order? - Help Center
seo.description: Learn when and how to cancel an order at Superior Hypermarket.

cancel.intro: You can cancel orders that are pending or confirmed.
steps: Go to My Orders and open order details.
If status is pending or confirmed, you will see the Cancel order button.
Confirm cancellation. Refund will be processed per payment method.
If already processing or shipped, contact us with the order number.
cancel.note: Cancellation is not possible once the order is processing or shipped.
cancel.related: For damaged product returns, see Returns & refunds.

address.title: Can I change the delivery address?

seo.title: Can I change the delivery address? - Help Center
seo.description: How to manage delivery address of your order at Superior Hypermarket.

address.intro: Address is frozen when the order is created and cannot be changed afterwards.
steps: If you have not checked out yet, change address at checkout.
For future orders, manage addresses in My Account > Addresses.
You can set an address as default.
If you made a mistake, cancel the order (if still possible) and create a new one with the correct address.
address.note: Order address cannot be edited once confirmed for logistics reasons.
address.related: Manage your addresses before purchase to avoid mistakes.

late-delivery.title: My order is delayed

seo.title: My order is delayed - Help Center
seo.description: What to do if your Superior Hypermarket order does not arrive on time.

late-delivery.intro: If your order does not arrive on the estimated date, first check its status.
steps: Check status in My Orders > Details. If processing or shipped, delivery is imminent.
Verify address and phone are correct.
Wait up to 24 additional hours for logistics delays.
If no update, contact us from this article with the order number and we will track it.
late-delivery.note: Orders with pending payment are not shipped until payment is confirmed.
late-delivery.related: Associate order number when contacting us to speed up help.

policy.title: Return policy

seo.title: Return policy - Help Center
seo.description: Learn the return policy of Superior Hypermarket for food and non-food products.

policy.intro: We work with fresh and consumable food products, so the policy is specific.
steps: Perishable foods (fruits, meats, dairy) are not returnable unless damaged or mistaken.
Non-perishables and appliances can be reported within 48h after delivery if defective or mistaken.
Keep packaging and photos of product and label.
Contact us from this article to register your case and we will guide you.
policy.note: We do not accept returns for remorse on perishables once delivered.
policy.related: If your product arrived damaged, check the specific article.

damaged.title: Damaged or incorrect product

seo.title: Damaged or incorrect product - Help Center
seo.description: How to report a damaged or incorrect product at Superior Hypermarket and request a solution.

damaged.intro: If you received a damaged, opened or different product, we will solve it.
steps: Take photos of product, label and packaging.
Contact us selecting the affected order and describe the issue.
Indicate if you prefer refund or replacement when available.
Our team will review your case and contact you with a solution.
damaged.note: Associating order number and photos speeds up handling.
damaged.related: Also check when your refund will be credited.

refund.title: When will I see my refund?

seo.title: When will I see my refund? - Help Center
seo.description: Refund timelines and methods at Superior Hypermarket.

refund.intro: Refunds are processed once the case is confirmed.
steps: After approving the return, refund is initiated within 24-48 hours.
If paid by card, you will see credit in 5-10 business days per your bank.
Cancelled pending payments generate no charge.
Contact us with order number if you do not see credit in time.
refund.note: There are no automatic refunds; they always require case review.
refund.related: First report the damaged or incorrect product.

create.title: How to create an account

seo.title: How to create an account - Help Center
seo.description: Create your Superior Hypermarket account to shop and manage orders.

create.intro: Creating an account lets you save addresses and see order history.
steps: Click Register in the header.
Complete name, email and password (min 8 chars).
Confirm password and accept terms.
Once registered, you will be signed in automatically.
create.note: Use a valid email you can access.
create.related: Trouble signing in? Check the related article.

login.title: I cannot sign in

seo.title: I cannot sign in - Help Center
seo.description: Solutions if you cannot sign in to Superior Hypermarket.

login.intro: If you cannot log in, check email and password.
steps: Make sure you use the same email you registered with.
Check caps and no trailing spaces when copying password.
If you forgot password, use recovery option (if enabled).
If you see 'too many attempts', wait a few minutes and try again.
login.note: After several failed attempts we apply temporary limit for security.
login.related: Still no account? Register in minutes.

data.title: Change my personal data

seo.title: Change my personal data - Help Center
seo.description: How to update name and email of your Superior Hypermarket account.

data.intro: You can view your data in My account.
steps: Go to My account after signing in.
There you will see name, email and role.
For changes you cannot do yourself, contact us indicating what to update.
We will verify identity before modifying sensitive data.
data.note: Email changes may require confirmation for security.
data.related: Also manage your addresses from Addresses.

logout.title: Sign out on another device

seo.title: Sign out on another device - Help Center
seo.description: How to sign out of Superior Hypermarket from any device.

logout.intro: You can sign out at any time.
steps: In account menu, click Sign out.
If you left session open on another device, sign out there as well.
For security, do not share your password.
If you suspect unauthorized use, contact us immediately.
logout.note: Signing out does not delete your order history.
logout.related: Keep your password safe and change it periodically.

methods.title: Available payment methods

seo.title: Available payment methods - Help Center
seo.description: Available payment methods at Superior Hypermarket.

methods.intro: We offer secure payment options to complete your purchase.
steps: During checkout you will see enabled methods (card, pending payment, etc.).
Pending payments require later confirmation in My orders.
We do not store card data outside payment provider.
If payment fails, try again or try another method.
methods.note: Exact method list may vary by availability.
methods.related: Do you have a pending payment order? Check the specific article.

pending.title: Pay a pending order

seo.title: Pay a pending order - Help Center
seo.description: How to pay an order in pending status at Superior Hypermarket.

pending.intro: If your order remained pending, you can pay it from details.
steps: Go to My orders and open the pending order.
If payment is pending, you will see the Pay button.
Click Pay and follow instructions.
Once paid, status will change to paid and preparation will start.
pending.note: Orders are not shipped until payment is confirmed.
pending.related: If payment fails, try again in a few minutes.

invoice.title: Do you issue an invoice?

seo.title: Do you issue an invoice? - Help Center
seo.description: Information about invoices and receipts at Superior Hypermarket.

invoice.intro: We issue a receipt for every purchase.
steps: After completing your order, you will get a receipt tied to order number.
If you need invoice with specific data, contact us with order number and fiscal data.
We do not generate automatic RNC invoices without request.
Our team will send the corresponding receipt.
invoice.note: Electronic invoicing is evolving; ask for special cases.
invoice.related: Always include order number when requesting invoice.

availability.title: Product out of stock or unavailable

seo.title: Product out of stock - Help Center
seo.description: What to do if a product is not available at Superior Hypermarket.

steps: If a product does not appear, try searching by name or filtering by category.
Out-of-stock products are not shown as addable.
Check again later; stock updates regularly.
If you look for a habitual product and it is missing, contact us to inform you.
availability.note: It is not possible to reserve out-of-stock products.
availability.related: Discover similar products in same category.

offers.title: How offers work

seo.title: How offers work - Help Center
seo.description: Understand how offers and discounts work at Superior Hypermarket.

offers.intro: Offers show original price, discounted price and percentage.
steps: Go to Offers to see discounted products.
Strikethrough price is original and highlighted is final price.
No coupon needed; discount applies automatically when adding to cart.
Offers have limited availability and may run out.
offers.note: Percentage is calculated over original price reported by supplier.
offers.related: Filter offers by category to find what you need.

search.title: I cannot find a product

seo.title: I cannot find a product - Help Center
seo.description: How to search for products at Superior Hypermarket.

search.intro: Use search to find products quickly.
steps: Type at least 2 chars in header search bar.
You can filter by category from search.
Check spelling or try synonyms (e.g., 'fridge' vs 'refrigerator').
If still not found, visit related category or contact us.
search.related: Explore categories to discover related products.

contact.title: Contact and support hours

seo.title: Contact and hours - Help Center
seo.description: Hours, phone and contact email of Superior Hypermarket.

contact.intro: We are available every day to help you.
steps: Email: soporte@hipermercadosuperior.com.
Hours: Monday to Sunday, 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM.
For order inquiries, include order number to speed up response.
contact.related: Want to pick up in store? Check pickup article.

pickup.title: Can I pick up my order in store?

seo.title: Can I pick up my order in store? - Help Center
seo.description: Information about in-store pickup at Superior Hypermarket.

pickup.intro: We currently do not offer standard in-store pickup.
steps: All orders are handled with home delivery via address.
Make sure to register your address correctly in Addresses.
If you need special coordination, contact us before purchase.
We will evaluate your case and indicate if alternative is available.
pickup.note: In-store pickup is under evaluation for future.
pickup.related: Manage your addresses for smooth deliveries.

privacy.title: Privacy and personal data

seo.title: Privacy and personal data - Help Center
seo.description: How Superior Hypermarket handles privacy and data protection.

privacy.intro: We respect your privacy and protect your data.
steps: Check Privacy Policy to learn what data we collect and how we use it.
You can request access, correction or deletion per applicable law.
We do not share your data with third parties without consent.
To exercise rights, contact us indicating request and associated email.
privacy.related: Also read Terms of Use for general conditions.

other.title: Other inquiries

seo.title: Other inquiries - Help Center
seo.description: Other general inquiries for Superior Hypermarket.

other.intro: If you did not find your topic, contact us directly.
steps: Check help categories in case your inquiry fits another topic.
Use contact form indicating category and detail.
Include all relevant info (order, product, account).
We will respond as soon as possible within support hours.
other.note: The more specific you are, the faster we can help.
other.related: Also visit legal pages for general info.
